subject: Glass squid
topic: Seven hundred meters down off Alaska, a squid so clear you can almost see right through it.
script:
Seven hundred meters down off Alaska, a squid so clear you can almost see right through it.
This is a glass squid.
That red shape in the middle is its digestive gland.
The white crescents on either side are its gills.
Being see-through is how it survives. In open water there's nowhere to hide, so it hides in plain sight.
Below each eye are light organs that can glow.
Scientists think they help hide the shadow of its eyes from hunters below.
And those twitching eye movements? Scientists think the squid was blinking.
Would you even notice it swimming past you?
